openings.zh-Hans: 周日了，我把这六天的信摊在桌上，慢慢写一封长一点的。
openings.en: It is Sunday. I have spread six days of letters across the table and am taking my time with a longer one.

openings.zh-Hans: 窗边的光正好够写信。这一周的路，我想和你一起再走一遍。
openings.en: There is just enough light by the window to write. I would like to walk through this week with you once more.

closings.zh-Hans: 信纸叠好了。下一段路，等明天再说。
closings.en: The pages are folded now. Tomorrow can tell us about the next stretch of road.

closings.zh-Hans: 我把笔放回邮包。愿你今天也有一小段不用赶路的时间。
closings.en: I have put the pen back in my mailbag. I hope there is a little unhurried time in your day too.

summary.zh-Hans: 周一到周六（{start} 至 {end}），我们走了 {distance}。
summary.en: From Monday through Saturday ({start} to {end}), we travelled {distance}.

tools.en: Our tools over those six days: {tools}.

noTools.zh-Hans: 这六天没有记录工具比例。
noTools.en: No tool breakdown was recorded for those six days.

trendUp.zh-Hans: 比上一周同样的周一到周六，多走了 {percent}%。
trendUp.en: We travelled {percent}% farther than the same Monday-to-Saturday period last week.

trendDown.zh-Hans: 比上一周同样的周一到周六，少走了 {percent}%。
trendDown.en: We travelled {percent}% less than the same Monday-to-Saturday period last week.

trendSame.zh-Hans: 和上一周同样的周一到周六相比，里程一样。
trendSame.en: Our distance matched the same Monday-to-Saturday period last week.

trendFromZero.zh-Hans: 上一周这六天没有走动，这周又上路了。
trendFromZero.en: Last week we stayed still over those six days. This week we were on the road again.

fulfilled.zh-Hans: 这周想留住的一件事，是我真的把你的话放进了旅途：{event}
fulfilled.en: The thing I want to keep from this week is how your words became part of the journey: {event}

rare.zh-Hans: 这周想留住的一件事，是带回了稀有的“{event}”。我把它放稳了，留着以后慢慢看。
rare.en: The thing I want to keep from this week is the rare souvenir, “{event}”. I have tucked it away safely for another look later.

country.zh-Hans: 这周想留住的一件事，是护照上第一次有了{event}的章。那一页我多翻了两遍。
country.en: The thing I want to keep from this week is our first passport stamp from {event}. I turned back to that page twice.

longest.zh-Hans: 这周走得最远的一天是 {date}，一共 {distance}。走完之后，我找了个有风的地方坐下。
longest.en: Our longest day this week was {date}, at {distance}. Afterwards I found a breezy place to sit.

quiet.zh-Hans: 这周没有要圈出来的大事。我还记得邮局有人来的时候，屋子里那一点动静。这样也很好。
quiet.en: There is no big event to circle this week. I still remember the little sounds when someone visited the post office. That is enough to keep.
